note: What a server sends to pause or resume a named group of particle emitters. The header carries no object this acts on.

fields.name: group
fields.note: The group's name, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: operation
fields.note: Nonzero to pause the emission, zero to resume it.

fields.name: groupOperation
fields.note: What to do with the group. A client acts on 0 only, pausing or resuming the group's emission, and does nothing for any other value.
